diagnosis: Suspected carcinoma of the breast.
notes: Histopathology of the core-cut specimen confirms invasive ductal carcinoma, no special type.
description: Histopathology for suspected breast carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected colorectal carcinoma.
notes: Histopathology of the colonoscopic biopsy confirms moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of the colon.
description: Histopathology for suspected colorectal carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected gastric carcinoma.
notes: Histopathology of the endoscopic biopsy confirms poorly differentiated gastric adenocarcinoma.
description: Histopathology for suspected gastric carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected papillary thyroid carcinoma.
notes: Histopathology of the thyroid nodule specimen confirms papillary thyroid carcinoma with classic nuclear features.
description: Histopathology for suspected papillary thyroid carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected soft tissue sarcoma of the thigh.
notes: Histopathology of the biopsy specimen confirms a high-grade pleomorphic soft tissue sarcoma.
description: Histopathology for suspected soft tissue sarcoma.

diagnosis: Suspected malignant melanoma of the back.
notes: Histopathology of the excised skin lesion confirms superficial spreading malignant melanoma with a Breslow thickness of 2.1 mm.
description: Histopathology for suspected malignant melanoma.

diagnosis: Suspected squamous cell carcinoma of the skin.
notes: Histopathology of the skin biopsy confirms well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with clear margins.
description: Histopathology for suspected cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected lymph node metastasis from an occult primary.
notes: Histopathology of the excised cervical lymph node confirms metastatic squamous cell carcinoma deposits.
description: Histopathology for suspected lymph node metastasis.

diagnosis: Tumour marker evaluation for suspected hepatocellular carcinoma.
notes: Serum alpha-fetoprotein is markedly elevated, supporting the imaging diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma.
description: Tumour marker evaluation for suspected hepatocellular carcinoma.

diagnosis: Receptor status evaluation in confirmed breast carcinoma.
notes: Immunohistochemistry shows strong estrogen and progesterone receptor positivity with HER2-negative status.
description: Immunohistochemistry for receptor status in breast carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected bone metastasis of the femur.
notes: Local X-ray of the femur shows a lytic lesion in the proximal shaft, suspicious for metastatic deposit.
description: Local X-ray for suspected bone metastasis.

diagnosis: Local extent assessment of a bony tumour of the tibia.
notes: Local X-ray of the tibia shows an expansile lesion with cortical thinning, in keeping with a primary bone tumour.
description: Local X-ray for local extent assessment of a bony tumour.

diagnosis: Suspected bone metastasis of the humerus.
notes: Local X-ray of the humerus shows a mixed lytic-sclerotic lesion suspicious for a metastatic deposit.
description: Local X-ray for suspected bone metastasis.

diagnosis: Local extent assessment of a pelvic bony tumour.
notes: Local X-ray of the pelvis shows an ill-defined destructive lesion involving the iliac bone.
description: Local X-ray for local extent assessment of a bony tumour.

diagnosis: Suspected bone metastasis of the vertebra.
notes: Local X-ray of the spine shows loss of vertebral body height with a lytic focus, suspicious for metastatic involvement.
description: Local X-ray for suspected bone metastasis.

diagnosis: Local extent (staging) assessment of carcinoma breast.
notes: Contrast-enhanced MRI breast shows a spiculated mass with chest-wall proximity, assisting local staging.
description: MRI for local extent staging of breast carcinoma.

diagnosis: Staging work-up of colorectal carcinoma.
notes: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis shows a circumferential colonic wall thickening with mesenteric lymphadenopathy.
description: CT scan for staging of colorectal carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected metastatic disease work-up in soft tissue sarcoma.
notes: Contrast-enhanced CT of the chest shows multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules suspicious for metastatic deposits.
description: CT scan for metastatic disease work-up.

diagnosis: Whole-body bone scan for metastatic screening in carcinoma breast.
notes: Whole-body bone scan shows multiple foci of increased tracer uptake in the spine and pelvis, consistent with skeletal metastases.
description: Whole-body bone scan for metastatic screening.

diagnosis: Local extent assessment of a retroperitoneal soft tissue sarcoma.
notes: Contrast-enhanced MRI of the abdomen shows a large heterogeneous retroperitoneal mass abutting the great vessels.
description: MRI for local extent assessment of retroperitoneal sarcoma.

diagnosis: Suspected carcinoma of the breast.
notes: Ultrasound-guided core-cut biopsy performed on the breast lump, specimen sent for histopathology and receptor studies.
description: Core-cut biopsy for suspected breast carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected soft tissue sarcoma of the thigh.
notes: Image-guided core-cut biopsy performed on the deep thigh mass under local anesthesia.
description: Core-cut biopsy for suspected soft tissue sarcoma.

diagnosis: Suspected carcinoma of the breast with an ill-defined mass.
notes: Ultrasound-guided core-cut biopsy performed with multiple passes to ensure adequate tissue yield.
description: Core-cut biopsy for suspected breast carcinoma.

diagnosis: Suspected malignant skin lesion of the forearm.
notes: Complete excisional biopsy of the pigmented skin lesion performed with a narrow margin for diagnostic purposes.
description: Excision biopsy for suspected malignant skin lesion.

diagnosis: Small suspicious soft tissue lump of the forearm.
notes: Excisional biopsy of the soft tissue lump performed for complete tissue diagnosis, specimen sent intact for histopathology.
description: Excision biopsy of a suspicious soft tissue lump.

diagnosis: Suspected malignant skin lesion of the scalp.
notes: Wide local excisional biopsy of the scalp lesion performed with primary closure.
description: Excision biopsy for suspected malignant skin lesion.

diagnosis: Suspected thyroid malignancy.
notes: Fine needle aspiration cytology performed on the dominant thyroid nodule under ultrasound guidance.
description: FNAC for suspected thyroid malignancy.

diagnosis: Suspected metastatic cervical lymph node.
notes: Fine needle aspiration cytology performed on the enlarged cervical lymph node.
description: FNAC for suspected metastatic lymph node.

diagnosis: Suspected thyroid malignancy with a dominant nodule.
notes: Ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration cytology performed with adequate cellular yield obtained.
description: FNAC for suspected thyroid malignancy.

diagnosis: Large unresectable soft tissue sarcoma requiring tissue diagnosis before neoadjuvant therapy.
notes: Incision biopsy performed on the large thigh mass to obtain adequate tissue for diagnosis prior to neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
description: Incision biopsy of a large unresectable tumour before neoadjuvant therapy.

diagnosis: Large unresectable locally advanced breast carcinoma.
notes: Incision biopsy performed on the fungating breast mass to confirm diagnosis before neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
description: Incision biopsy of a large unresectable tumour before neoadjuvant therapy.

diagnosis: Large unresectable retroperitoneal tumour requiring tissue diagnosis.
notes: Incision biopsy performed on the retroperitoneal mass under image guidance prior to planned neoadjuvant therapy.
description: Incision biopsy of a large unresectable tumour before neoadjuvant therapy.

diagnosis: Early carcinoma of the breast requiring nodal staging.
notes: Sentinel lymph node biopsy performed using dual dye and radioisotope mapping, two sentinel nodes identified and excised.
description: Sentinel lymph node biopsy for early breast carcinoma nodal staging.

diagnosis: Malignant melanoma requiring nodal staging.
notes: Sentinel lymph node biopsy performed with lymphoscintigraphy mapping to the regional nodal basin.
description: Sentinel lymph node biopsy for melanoma nodal staging.

diagnosis: Early carcinoma of the breast with clinically node-negative axilla.
notes: Sentinel lymph node biopsy performed with blue dye mapping, sentinel node sent for frozen section examination.
description: Sentinel lymph node biopsy for early breast carcinoma nodal staging.
